doc.brief: The possible accessible states of a [`Accessible`](xref:gtk:Accessible).
doc.md: The possible accessible states of a [`Accessible`](xref:gtk:Accessible).

busy.brief: A “busy” state. This state has boolean values
busy.md: A “busy” state. This state has boolean values

checked.brief: A “checked” state; indicates the current state of a [`CheckButton`](xref:gtk:CheckButton).
checked.md:
A “checked” state; indicates the current
  state of a [`CheckButton`](xref:gtk:CheckButton). Value type: [`AccessibleTristate`](xref:gtk:AccessibleTristate)

disabled.brief: A “disabled” state; corresponds to the [`Widget:sensitive`](xref:gtk:Widget#property:sensitive) property.
disabled.md:
A “disabled” state; corresponds to the
  [`Widget:sensitive`](xref:gtk:Widget#property:sensitive) property. It indicates a UI element
  that is perceivable, but not editable or operable. Value type: boolean

expanded.brief: An “expanded” state; corresponds to the [`Expander:expanded`](xref:gtk:Expander#property:expanded) property.
expanded.md:
An “expanded” state; corresponds to the
  [`Expander:expanded`](xref:gtk:Expander#property:expanded) property. Value type: boolean
  or undefined

hidden.brief: A “hidden” state; corresponds to the [`Widget:visible`](xref:gtk:Widget#property:visible) property.
hidden.md:
A “hidden” state; corresponds to the
  [`Widget:visible`](xref:gtk:Widget#property:visible) property. You can use this state
  explicitly on UI elements that should not be exposed to an assistive
  technology. Value type: boolean
  See also: %GTK_ACCESSIBLE_STATE_DISABLED

invalid.brief: An “invalid” state; set when a widget is showing an error.
invalid.md:
An “invalid” state; set when a widget
  is showing an error. Value type: [`AccessibleInvalidState`](xref:gtk:AccessibleInvalidState)

pressed.brief: A “pressed” state; indicates the current state of a [`ToggleButton`](xref:gtk:ToggleButton).
pressed.md:
A “pressed” state; indicates the current
  state of a [`ToggleButton`](xref:gtk:ToggleButton). Value type: [`AccessibleTristate`](xref:gtk:AccessibleTristate)
  enumeration

selected.brief: A “selected” state; set when a widget is selected.
selected.md:
A “selected” state; set when a widget
  is selected. Value type: boolean or undefined

visited.brief: Indicates that a widget with the GTK_ACCESSIBLE_ROLE_LINK has been visited.
visited.md:
Indicates that a widget with the GTK_ACCESSIBLE_ROLE_LINK has been visited.
Value type: boolean.

init_value.brief: Initializes `value` with the appropriate type for the `state`.
init_value.md:
Initializes `value` with the appropriate type for the `state`.

This function is mostly meant for language bindings, in conjunction
with gtk_accessible_update_relation_state().
